public class RemainingContractHarness {
 static long checks;static Random rng=new Random(20261018L);
 static void yes(boolean a,String s){checks++;if(!a)throw new AssertionError(s);}
 static void eq(long a,long b,String s){yes(a==b,s+": "+a+" != "+b);}
 static void same(Object a,Object b,String s){yes(Objects.equals(a,b),s+": "+a+" != "+b);}
 static void arr(int[] a,int[] b,String s){yes(Arrays.equals(a,b),s);}
 static int[][] cp(int[][] a){return Arrays.stream(a).map(int[]::clone).toArray(int[][]::new);}
 static void mat(int[][] a,int[][] b,String s){yes(Arrays.deepEquals(a,b),s);}
 static int[] rand(int n,int bound){int[] a=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)a[i]=rng.nextInt(bound);return a;}
 static String chars(int n,String abc){StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)s.append(abc.charAt(rng.nextInt(abc.length())));return s.toString();}
 static void group(String name,long begin){System.out.println(name+": "+(checks-begin)+" checks passed");}
 static long rain(int[] a){long total=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){int l=a[i],r=a[i];for(int j=0;j<i;j++)l=Math.max(l,a[j]);for(int j=i+1;j<a.length;j++)r=Math.max(r,a[j]);total+=Math.min(l,r)-a[i];}return total;}
 static Set<String> triplets(int[] a){Set<String>s=new TreeSet<>();for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<a.length;j++)for(int k=j+1;k<a.length;k++)if((long)a[i]+a[j]+a[k]==0){int[] t={a[i],a[j],a[k]};Arrays.sort(t);s.add(Arrays.toString(t));}return s;}
 static Set<String> triples(List<List<Integer>> a){Set<String>s=new TreeSet<>();for(List<Integer> t:a){int[] b=t.stream().mapToInt(x->x).toArray();Arrays.sort(b);yes(s.add(Arrays.toString(b)),"triplet unique output");}return s;}
 static int longest(String s,int k){int b=0;for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++){Set<Character>x=new HashSet<>();for(int j=i;j<s.length();j++){x.add(s.charAt(j));if(x.size()<=k)b=Math.max(b,j-i+1);}}return b;}
 static boolean permutation(String p,String s){char[] a=p.toCharArray();Arrays.sort(a);for(int i=0;i+a.length<=s.length();i++){char[] b=s.substring(i,i+a.length).toCharArray();Arrays.sort(b);if(Arrays.equals(a,b))return true;}return false;}
 static String minWindow(String s,String t){String best="";for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++)for(int j=i+1;j<=s.length();j++){int[] c=new int[128];for(char x:s.substring(i,j).toCharArray())c[x]++;boolean ok=true;for(char x:t.toCharArray())if(--c[x]<0)ok=false;if(ok&&(best.isEmpty()||j-i<best.length()))best=s.substring(i,j);}return best;}
 static long subarrays(int[] a,int target){long n=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){long sum=0;for(int j=i;j<a.length;j++){sum+=a[j];if(sum==target)n++;}}return n;}
 static int atoiOracle(String s){int i=0;while(i<s.length()&&s.charAt(i)==' ')i++;int sign=1;if(i<s.length()&&(s.charAt(i)=='+'||s.charAt(i)=='-'))sign=s.charAt(i++)=='-'?-1:1;int start=i;while(i<s.length()&&s.charAt(i)>='0'&&s.charAt(i)<='9')i++;if(start==i)return 0;BigInteger v=new BigInteger(s.substring(start,i)).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(sign));return v.max(BigInteger.valueOf(Integer.MIN_VALUE)).min(BigInteger.valueOf(Integer.MAX_VALUE)).intValue();}
 static int versions(String a,String b){String[] x=a.split("\\."),y=b.split("\\.");for(int i=0;i<Math.max(x.length,y.length);i++){int c=new BigInteger(i<x.length?x[i]:"0").compareTo(new BigInteger(i<y.length?y[i]:"0"));if(c!=0)return Integer.signum(c);}return 0;}
 static int[][] zeroOracle(int[][] a){int[][] b=cp(a);for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)for(int j=0;j<a[0].length;j++)if(a[i][j]==0){Arrays.fill(b[i],0);for(int k=0;k<a.length;k++)b[k][j]=0;}return b;}
 static List<Integer> spiral(int[][] a){int m=a.length,n=a[0].length,r=0,c=0,d=0;int[][] dirs={{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1},{-1,0}};boolean[][] used=new boolean[m][n];List<Integer> out=new ArrayList<>();for(int x=0;x<m*n;x++){out.add(a[r][c]);used[r][c]=true;int nr=r+dirs[d][0],nc=c+dirs[d][1];if(nr<0||nr==m||nc<0||nc==n||used[nr][nc]){d=(d+1)%4;nr=r+dirs[d][0];nc=c+dirs[d][1];}r=nr;c=nc;}return out;}
 static int bouquet(int[] a,int m,int k){for(int day:Arrays.stream(a).distinct().sorted().toArray()){int count=0,run=0;for(int x:a){if(x<=day)run++;else{count+=run/k;run=0;}}count+=run/k;if(count>=m)return day;}return -1;}
 static long grid(int[][] a,int r,int c){if(r==a.length-1&&c==a[0].length-1)return a[r][c];long v=Long.MAX_VALUE;if(r+1<a.length)v=Math.min(v,grid(a,r+1,c));if(c+1<a[0].length)v=Math.min(v,grid(a,r,c+1));return a[r][c]+v;}
 static String cli(Class<?> cl,String input)throws Exception{InputStream old=System.in;PrintStream oldOut=System.out;ByteArrayOutputStream bytes=new ByteArrayOutputStream();try{System.setIn(new ByteArrayInputStream(input.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));System.setOut(new PrintStream(bytes));cl.getMethod("main",String[].class).invoke(null,(Object)new String[0]);}finally{System.setIn(old);System.setOut(oldOut);}return bytes.toString(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim().replaceAll("\\s+"," ");}
 static void probe(String name){switch(name){case "atoi":eq(new LC8().myAtoi("１"),0,"ASCII digit predicate");break;case "atoi-fold2":eq(F_p_array_2.solve("１"),0,"legacy fold2 ASCII predicate");break;case "atoi-fold3":eq(F_p_array_3.solve("１"),0,"legacy fold3 ASCII predicate");break;case "rotate":eq(Scalar.rotate(1000000000,1500000000),1000000000,"rotation scalar avoids add overflow");break;case "heap":yes(!Scalar.enterHeap(1073741824,Integer.MAX_VALUE),"leaf does not enter child arithmetic");break;case "mid":eq(Scalar.mid(1500000000,1600000000),1550000000,"nonnegative index midpoint");break;default:throw new AssertionError(name);}}
